headline: Six Fronts Keep the Base Ledger in Motion
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest movement has shifted toward Olavis Wake, where four base events arrived in the latest two hours and 22 in the past day, alongside rapidly rising casualty and enlistment rates. Weathered Expanse remains the war’s busiest district: 61 events were recorded in 24 hours, including six in the latest two, while its ledger now shows three Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral bases. Linn Mercy continues to grind around Outwich Ranch, with two fresh events and 18 for the day; Marban Hollow also remains unsettled, posting two recent events amid 26 daily. Pari Peak has two latest-window events and 24 across the day. Kuura Strand’s earlier rush has cooled in the latest two hours, though seven events in six hours and 17 for the day leave its three-Warden, three-Colonial balance under watch. Nevish Line has gone quiet in the latest two hours after six events in six hours. Gutter, once a furious exchange, likewise records no fresh action, despite 40 daily events.
